name: Meckenheim (Germany)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the city arms of Meckenheim (a black cross with a lion on white in an ornate shield).
history: Municipal flag of Meckenheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Meckenheim arms — cross with lion on white
